title: Base64 basic-auth credential in the client configuration
description: .npmrc declares a base64 `user:password` credential written into the checked-in client configuration. Base64 is encoding, not encryption: the pair decodes with one command, so the account can be used until the password is changed.
remediation: Read the credential from the environment and switch the account to a scoped token.
limitation: It matches a base64 `user:password` credential written into the checked-in client configuration in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
